critical_bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: File contained TWO copies of the component: the new Phase 2A version (lines 1-191 — with sessions-card) AND the old Phase 1 version (lines 193-300 — placeholder-only). Result: duplicate `const STATUS_STYLES` + duplicate `export default function Profile()` → JS parse error 'Identifier STATUS_STYLES has already been declared'. The Profile route would fail to compile, and even a successful HMR build would only bind the second (old) export, so the sessions-card would never render.

server.py forgot-password: `origin` fallback uses request.headers.get('host') which behind ingress may not equal the public host. Currently OK because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and public host align, but if the CRM is ever fronted with different hosts, the reset link may point to the internal one. Consider FRONTEND_URL env-driven link.
server.py /sessions/{jti}/revoke: no rate limit — a compromised user token could churn revocations. Low risk but worth noting.

server.py forgot-password creates a NEW token every call — old tokens for the same user are NOT invalidated. A user requesting 3 resets has 3 valid tokens for 1h. Consider $set used=true on prior tokens on new request.
auth.py get_current_user updates last_active_at once per 60s but not gated for missing jti — fine, best-effort.

rca_of_the_issue: Profile.jsx BLOCKER: two `export default function Profile` blocks and duplicate `const STATUS_STYLES` in the same module → JS parse error. Detected via eslint before running any UI test; the file compiled only because CRA/webpack silently used the second export (which lacked the sessions-card entirely) — meaning even if it had compiled, the sessions feature would be invisible. Fixed by trimming file to first 192 lines. Reproduce with `yarn eslint src/pages/Profile.jsx`. Mitigation: add pre-commit eslint gate + integration test that navigates to /profile and asserts sessions-card renders.
